components.name: Enter Ring

components.css: .ds-enter-ring{position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden;width:112px;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid #653641;background:transparent;color:#653641;display:grid;place-content:center;justify-items:center;gap:6px;padding:0;margin:12px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 0 0 8px #f6eee4,0 0 0 9px #bb8c5070;transition:color .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),transform .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-enter-ring::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:-1px;z-index:-1;border-radius:50%;background:#653641;transform:scale(0);transition:transform .6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-enter-ring:hover,.ds-enter-ring:focus-visible{color:#f6eee4;transform:rotate(-4deg)}.ds-enter-ring:hover::before,.ds-enter-ring:focus-visible::before{transform:scale(1)}.ds-enter-ring:active{transform:scale(.96)}.ds-enter-ring:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #b25b76;outline-offset:15px}.ds-enter-label{font:italic 400 23px/1 'Bodoni Moda Variable','Bodoni Moda',Didot,Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:-.01em}.ds-enter-ring svg{width:21px;height:21px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.5;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-enter-ring:hover svg,.ds-enter-ring:focus-visible svg{transform:translateX(5px)}

narrative.overview:
An intimate birthday table, viewed from just above a seated person's eye line. The scene itself leads. A walnut pedestal table, ivory linen, pink cake, and paper-and-ink keepsake sit in a warm pool of light. Typography and controls stay at the periphery of the cake scene; no dashboard cards or UI-chrome labels in the gift. The supplied assets and the user's selected candlelit direction are the visual authority: do not reopen a concept tournament or replace the supplied models with generated imagery.

The gift moves from paper to night and unfolds in order. It opens on warm paper with the date set small and exact in Bodoni above her portrait, a print-white framed photograph that fills the middle of the screen; the greeting and a round Enter sit beneath it. Entering dissolves the paper to night cocoa, and a quiet full-screen terminal types to her in a cursive monospace. The cake room then lights in stages: one flame alone in the dark, a dozen sparkles rising, then the room. The paper surfaces (welcome, gallery, letter, prints) and the dark surfaces (terminal, cake room) share one ink family.

The signature is the candle-first intro and the memories that follow the wish: once the flame is blown out, print-white photos pop from the cake on a spring and settle in a row, a print-white hint points to the letter on the table, and reading it to the end opens the gallery. Motion is concentrated in these transitions; reduced-motion users get the same story without flicker or travel.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and rose ink by day; night cocoa, scene night and candle ivory after Enter.
Bodoni Moda for Latin display, Noto Serif Lao for the Lao wish; Victor Mono only in the terminal.
Physical paper is print white: the portrait mat, polaroids, the letter hint and the photo viewer.
Circles, pills and hairlines: round and pill controls, 1px brass or ink rules, small corners on paper objects.
Motion is slow, eased (cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)) and story-bearing; only the photo pop overshoots (cubic-bezier(.34,1.45,.64,1)).

rules.name: The Scene Owns the Chrome Rule
rules.body: The browser theme-color follows the scene: paper on welcome, cocoa in the terminal, scene night thereafter.

rules.name: The Brass Is Metal Rule
rules.body: Brass appears as line, halo or punctuation, never as a filled shape. On the welcome it is exactly the two date dots, one vertical rule and the Enter halo.

rules.name: The Print White Rule
rules.body: Anything that is a physical print or card in the story is print white, never paper and never pure #fff; paper is the ground, print sits on it or on the night.

rules.name: The Optical Size Rule
rules.body: The display date always sets opsz 96; do not let the browser pick a text-size cut for it.

rules.name: The Lao Gets a Serif Rule
rules.body: Lao display text is Noto Serif Lao, never the Latin Didone's fallback and never the body sans at display size.

rules.name: The Terminal-Only Mono Rule
rules.body: Victor Mono never appears outside the terminal.

rules.name: The Physical Object Rule
rules.body: Shadows belong to things that could exist on the table (the portrait print, photos, the hint card, the letter, the viewer mat), to the raised microphone pill, or to a state response; never to layout containers.

dos: Do set the welcome date in Bodoni at opsz 96 with the 9 italic in Dusk Rose and brass dots.
Do frame photographs as prints: Portrait Mat on the welcome, Print White everywhere in the cake room and viewer.
Do set Lao display text in Noto Serif Lao; keep Victor Mono inside the terminal.
Do keep peach as the only fill on the dark room, always with Pill Ink text.
Do switch theme-color with the scene (paper, cocoa, scene night).
Do give reduced-motion users the same story with durations collapsed.
Do use the supplied cake, letter models and photos; take user copy (captions, hint, backup label, UI strings) from content.json verbatim.
donts: Don't set body text or small labels in Dusk Rose or Blush on paper or print; they are display-scale accents.
Don't fill shapes with brass; it is a hairline, halo and punctuation metal.
Don't add window chrome, title bars or traffic lights to the terminal; it is a full-screen voice.
Don't show the backup blow button before the microphone has failed.
Don't replace the supplied models with generated imagery or box the cake room in dashboard cards.
